title: Mulva Cultural Center

services.name: Bus Tours
services.desc: Plan your next group visit or school field trip to Mulva Cultural Center in De Pere, Wisconsin. We welcome K-12 schools, homeschool groups, youth groups, adult groups, non-profit organizations and bus tours to experience our world-class exhibits, films, and educational programs. Groups of over 15 people will need to make special reservations at least two weeks in advance. Explore add-on activities, and guided tours designed to make your group’s visit memorable and meaningful. Thank you for your interest in scheduling a field trip to Mulva Cultural Center. We look forward to welcoming your group! Please complete this initial form so we can schedule an engaging and educational experience

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Located in the heart of De Pere, Mulva Cultural Center is a vibrant destination where art, culture, and community come together. Visitors can enjoy world-class exhibits, thought-provoking films in the state-of-the-art theater, engaging events for all ages, and exceptional dining with scenic views.
